title: Biomimetic liposomes in drug delivery: from design mechanisms to applications
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00440C, Review Article
Open Access

Zhi Li, Mengwen Li, Jianqin Lu
This review summarizes advances in biomimetic liposome-based delivery systems, highlighting design strategies such as membrane integration and applications in targeted therapy, imaging, immunomodulation, gene delivery, and vaccines.
